# v0.4 interaction fixture

`reportlab.pdf` is generated by `generate_reportlab.py` (ReportLab, used only
to generate this test asset). It contains two flat `/Fit` bookmarks, one
internal page link, one HTTPS URI link, a text field, and a required checkbox.
No third-party PDF document or font data was copied into the repository.

Regenerate with `python3 generate_reportlab.py reportlab.pdf` from this
directory. The binary need not be byte-for-byte reproducible because PDF
document IDs and metadata may differ; the structural assertions in
`pdf/tests/v04_external.rs` are the regression contract.

`qpdf-attachment.pdf` is produced from `reportlab.pdf` and `attachment.txt`
using:

```sh
qpdf reportlab.pdf --add-attachment attachment.txt -- qpdf-attachment.pdf
```

This tests reading an embedded file created by an independent PDF writer.

`pypdf-square.pdf` is generated from `reportlab.pdf` by
`generate_pypdf.py`; it adds an external Square annotation and a flat named
destination. Regenerate with
`python3 generate_pypdf.py reportlab.pdf pypdf-square.pdf` from this directory.
